newsitem.title: FRANCE: Metaleurop seeks full Nordenham output by end-Sept.
newsitem.headline: Metaleurop seeks full Nordenham output by end-Sept.

text.p: Metaleurop said on Wednesday that it hoped that its 90,000 tonnes lead plant in Nordenham, Germany, would reach full capacity at the end of September.
"The objective is to reach full capacity at the end of the financial year, that is at end September 1997," a company spokeswoman told Reuters.
She also said that the plant had been operating at around 50 percent of capacity since its initial start-up a year ago.
Metaleurop resumed production at the smelter at end January after shutting it earlier in the month for technical adjustments and repairs.
Metaleurop, a unit of Preussag AG, initially started production at the new low-cost smelter plant in March 1996.
It then said output at the new plant would be limited to 70 percent of capacity during the first 12 months of operation.
It later cut that target to 50-55 percent after the smelter was closed for technical adjustments between July and September 1996.
